releases.title: Multi-Channel Retailer Differentiates Itself with Rapid Growth and a Clear Path to Profitability (RedEnvelope secures $33 million third venture round)
releases.summary: RedEnvelope announced a $33 million third venture financing round led by Direct Equity Partners, and named Claire Gruppo to its board. Press contact: Amy Burke Bessette, RedEnvelope, (415) 371-9100 x237, aburke@redenvelope.com.
releases.text:
August 21, 2000
Press Contact: Amy Burke Bessette, RedEnvelope, (415) 371-9100 x237, aburke@redenvelope.com

MULTI-CHANNEL RETAILER DIFFERENTIATES ITSELF WITH RAPID GROWTH AND A CLEAR PATH TO PROFITABILITY

(San Francisco, CA-August 21, 2000) RedEnvelope (www.RedEnvelope.com), a leading multi-channel retailer of stylish gifts, today announced that it has secured its third venture round of financing for $33 million. RedEnvelope continues to outperform its business plan having achieved more than 400 %+ sales growth and 40%+ gross margins, establishing itself as one of the leading multi-channel business models born on the Internet.

Leading the round of financing is Direct Equity Partners, a venture between Madison Dearborn Partners and Gruppo, Levey & Co. which invests in direct marketing and e-commerce companies. Other new investors are Atrium Capital, Comdisco Ventures and Crown Technology Partners. Previous financial partners also participating in this funding are Sequoia Capital, Weston Presidio Capital, Sippl MacDonald Ventures, Silicon Valley Angel Fund, and Philips-Smith Specialty Retail Group.

"RedEnvelope's management team brings many years of direct marketing experience honed at category leaders such as Williams-Sonoma and Pottery Barn," says Patricia G. Campbell, President and Managing Director of Direct Equity Partners. "By applying that discipline to the Internet, RedEnvelope has achieved remarkable success in meeting consumers' gift-purchasing needs. Our $15 million investment, coupled with those of the other investors, will fuel this rapidly growing, multi-channel direct marketing enterprise."

With this last round of financing, RedEnvelope is uniquely demonstrating that specialty, non-commodity, retail can thrive on-line. The powerful combination of proprietary products, merchandising strength, high customer retention rates and a clear path to profitability, has attracted some very strong and savvy partners to invest in the 10-month-old company. The capital investment will be used to extend RedEnvelope's existing online and off-line marketing effort, build technology, increase brand awareness and acquire new customers. They will also use it to ramp up inventory for the holiday season, expand the fulfillment and customer service centers and for general operational expenses.

In conjunction with the financing, RedEnvelope also announced that Claire Gruppo, Managing Director for Direct Equity Partners, has been named to RedEnvelope's Board of Directors, bringing the number of board members to 8.

"Direct Equity Partners invests in multi-channel retailers who understand that great brands cannot survive in one channel alone," says Martin McClanan, Chief Executive Officer for RedEnvelope. "While the Internet will remain our main channel, our catalog and other means to engage our customer represent a huge opportunity for consumers to learn about the creative and exciting gift ideas at RedEnvelope. Direct Equity is the perfect partner to help us maximize the potential for efficiency and growth of all of our channels."

About RedEnvelope Gifts Online
Based in San Francisco, RedEnvelope's refined selection of stylish merchandise and simple, elegant design makes the process of finding, selecting and purchasing a gift online effortless. The name comes from a tradition in many Asian countries- which lives on today - of presenting special gifts in a red envelope. In the spirit of this tradition, gifts purchased from RedEnvelope are accompanied by a personalized message in a red envelope. Several unique features help guide customers to the gift they want including: GiftSearch, GiftReminder, 911Gifts (guaranteed overnight delivery), online customer service, multiple addressing and an inventory system that tracks in real-time to ensure that every item featured on the site is available.

About Direct Equity Partners
Direct Equity Partners (www.directequitypartners.com) was launched in 1999 by the parent company of Gruppo, Levey & Co., an investment banking firm, and Madison Dearborn Capital Partners III LP., a leading private equity investment fund, in response to the growing convergence between the direct marketing and e-commerce industries. Direct Equity Partners began with $100 million in capital. Portfolio companies include Atelier America, Inc., the leading manufacturer and direct marketer of textured, framed decorative artwork reproduction, and Mascot Network, the leading provider of campus intranet communities.

Gruppo, Levey & Co. (www.glconline.com) is a boutique investment banking firm serving all segments of the direct marketing and e-commerce industries. The firm provides merger and acquisition, financial and strategic advisory services to public and private companies and private equity groups, and has gained widespread recognition for translating its direct marketing experience to the rapidly expanding channel of e-commerce.

Madison Dearborn Partners (MDP) (www.mdcp.com), headquartered in Chicago, is a leading private equity investment firm with more than $7 billion of capital under management. MDP invests in market-leading and growth-oriented business in several sectors: consumer/ecommerce, communications, basic industries, healthcare and financial services.

About Sequoia
Steve Jobs and Steve Wozniak (Apple Computer), Larry Ellison (Oracle), Sandy Lerner and Len Bozack (Cisco Systems), Jerry Yang and David Filo (Yahoo!), Michael Robertson (MP3), Louis Borders (Webvan), Wilf Corrigan (LSI Logic), Bob Swanson (Linear Technology), Eric Greenberg and Bob Howe (Scient), are just a few of the people who have chosen Sequoia Capital to provide their original start-up venture capital financing and more importantly, help turn their ideas into companies.

The people backed and supported by Sequoia Capital since 1972 have built companies that now have a combined market value approaching one trillion dollars ($800B). Sequoia Capital's Internet portfolio includes: eToys, eGroups, PlanetRx, Chipshot, LinkExchange (acquired by Microsoft), AtWeb (acquired by Netscape), BillPoint (acquired by eBay) and Global Center (acquired by Frontier). For more information visit the Sequoia Capital website - www.sequoiacap.com.

About Weston Presidio Capital
Weston Presidio Capital is an investment partnership, which invests equity capital into privately-held growth companies. With offices in San Francisco and Boston, the company's professionals have more than 130 years of private equity investment experience, having worked with over 200 companies to achieve their business objectives. With $2 billion under management, Weston Presidio's strategy is to originate investment opportunities in a diverse set of industries and companies operated by management teams with proven records of success. The firm focuses its investment activities primarily on growth companies, recapitalizations and buyouts. Weston Presidio makes investments in all types of private enterprises including ones that are closely-held, family-controlled, or initially financed by institutional investors. Representative prior investments include Wild Oats Markets, Restoration Hardware, Guitar Centers, Tweeter Home Entertainment Group, and other specialty retailers.

Press Contact: Amy Burke Bessette, RedEnvelope, (415) 371-9100 x237, aburke@redenvelope.com

REDENVELOPE GIFTS ONLINE ENHANCES ITS CUSTOMER SERVICE PLATFORM WITH FACETIME SOLUTION
FACETIME'S REAL-TIME COMMUNICATIONS SOLUTION PROVIDES INSTANT CUSTOMER CARE TO REDENVELOPE SHOPPERS DURING THE BUSY HOLIDAY SEASON

FOSTER CITY, Calif.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--Dec. 2, 1999--RedEnvelope Gifts Online and FaceTime Communications today announced that RedEnvelope has implemented the FaceTime communications platform to add person-to-person, real-time customer care, and address customer needs ranging from inventory availability to gift choices.

RedEnvelope, the leading online gift site entering its third holiday season, has already made a strong commitment to customer service with real-time inventory and ease of gift search by lifestyle, gift occasion, recipient and price.

FaceTime Communications, the exclusive AOL licensee to run real-time commercial customer service applications on the AOL Instant Messenger Network, is a leading provider of real-time, person-to-person online communications solutions. These solutions enable e-retailers such as RedEnvelope to provide online shoppers with live customer assistance, creating a satisfied and loyal customer.

FaceTime created the new communications platform that uses real-time instant messaging as the foundation of a complete, open infrastructure to support a robust e-business strategy.

"The implementation of the FaceTime instant messaging platform comes on the heels of significant improvements in RedEnvelope's market leading back-end technology," said Christopher Cunningham, chief information officer at RedEnvelope. "The real-time chat function dovetails perfectly with our fully integrated system to provide inventory status, projected availability dates and now personalized gift-giving advice."

David Hsieh, co-founder of FaceTime Communications, said: "RedEnvelope, with its already strong commitment to customer service, has selected FaceTime to take this commitment to the next level. Other e-tailers who have implemented FaceTime have experienced significant sales increases and improved customer loyalty. The FaceTime solution provides RedEnvelope customers with the personal touch necessary for this busy holiday shopping season."

About RedEnvelope Gifts Online
Based in San Francisco, RedEnvelope's refined selection of stylish merchandise and simple, elegant design makes the process of finding, selecting and purchasing a gift online easy and hassle-free. The name comes from an Asian tradition which lives on today of presenting special gifts with a red envelope. In the spirit of this tradition, gifts purchased from RedEnvelope are accompanied by a personalized message in a red envelope.

Several unique features help guide customers to the gift they want including: GiftSearch, GiftReminder, 911Gifts (guaranteed overnight delivery), online customer service, multiple addressing and an inventory system that tracks in real-time to ensure that every item featured on the site is available.

About FaceTime Communications
FaceTime Communications provides services that transform customer interaction into a critical e-business resource. Headquartered in Foster City, the company's customers are some of the hottest names in e-business, including CallTech, Snap.com, Compaq, iGO.com, fatbrain.com, Mammothgolf.com, RedEnvelope, Yellow Freight and F1-4Help. World-recognized venture capital companies Mohr Davidow, Sutter Hill Ventures and IVP fund the company. FaceTime's executive management team has extensive experience in Internet and customer care businesses. For more information, visit FaceTime Communications at www.facetime.net or call 650/574-1600

FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE: May 22, 2000 [sic; header on archived page; release dated November 16, 1999]
Press Contacts: Amy Burke, RedEnvelope.com, 415.371.9100 x237, aburke@redenvelope.com | Greg Gibson, Susan Magrino Agency, 212.957.3005, greg@smapr.com

REDENVELOPE GIFTS ONLINE CLOSES $10 MILLION ROUND OF FINANCING FOR A TOTAL OF $31 MILLION RAISED SINCE AUGUST 1999
PREMIER GIFT SITE KICKS OFF ITS THIRD HOLIDAY SEASON WITH ADDITIONAL INVESTMENT, AND SIGNIFICANT NEW E-COMMERCE PARTNERSHIPS AND EXTENSIVE National Marketing Campaign

(SAN FRANCISCO, CA - November 16, 1999) - The internet's premier gift site, RedEnvelope Gifts Online, prepares for its third holiday season with an additional $10 million in financing from prominent retail and e-commerce backers Weston Presidio and Phillips-Smith, bringing the total raised since August 1999 to $31 million. The financing was led by Weston Presidio whose investment portfolio includes Restoration Hardware (Nasdaq:RSTO), Map Quest, Wild Oats Markets (Nasdaq:OATS), Medscape (Nasdaq: MSCP) and Vitria (Nasdaq:VITR). Additional investment came from Phillips-Smith, an e-commerce and consumer private equity group, who has invested in companies such as garden.com (Nasdaq:GDEN), Cheap Tickets, (Nasdaq:CTIX), Hot Topic (Nasdaq: HOTT), PETsMART (Nasdaq:PETM), EMusic (Nasdaq:EMUS), Cooking.com and Jamba Juice.

Formerly 911Gifts.com, RedEnvelope closed on a $21 Million round of financing in August led by blue chip venture capital firm Sequoia Capital. Sequoia has funded such companies as eToys (Nasdaq:ETYS), MP3.com (Nasdaq: MPPP), WebVan (Nasdaq:WBVN), Next Card (Nasdaq:NXCD), and Yahoo! (Nasdaq:YHOO).

The recent funding allows RedEnvelope to build on its 300% year over year revenue growth and solidify its leadership position as the internet's only solution for every gifting occasionpremier gift resource for every occasion. Entering the 1999 holiday season, the company has expanded its product offerings to include a greater selection of branded as well as custom designed products for every recipient and lifestyle with most products available for overnight delivery.

In addition, the company has launched begun an aggressive $15 million national marketing campaign featuring print and outdoor advertising as well as several new e-commerce partnerships. Ask Jeeves, Inc. (Nasdaq:ASKJ) announced today that RedEnvelope is a featured e-commerce provider on their new shopping service at Ask.com. On November 2nd Microsoft (Nasdaq:MSFT) designated RedEnvelope the premier gift anchor merchant on MSN's newly relaunched eShop. RedEnvelope's strategic positioning has enabled them to form featured similar partnerships with Excite, Yahoo! (Nasdaq:YHOO) and Women.com, as well as the premier anchor tenancy on AOL (NYSE:AOL), Netscape, CompuServe, and MSNBC. Other established relationships include PlanetOut.com, Lovingyou.com, eGroups.com, FamilyPoint.com, iVillage.com, (Nasdaq:IVIL), Egreetings.com, Salon.com (Nasdaq:SALN), and ShopNow.com. These alliances ensure RedEnvelope prominent placement, links, and catalogue exposure.

"We are pleased to have Weston Presidio and Philips-Smith join our prestigious group of investment partners," says RedEnvelope President and CEO Hilary Billings. "These firms are managed by the most experienced consumer private equity investors in the United States. They understand that only companies with well crafted marketing, merchandising and operating strategies are going to make it through this year's holiday season and they recognize the value we are creating at RedEnvelope."

Weston Presidio's President X X General Partner Jim McElwee comments, "RedEnvelope has employed a variety of innovative strategies to establish itself as a leader in the online gift area. We see in Hilary's vision a real understanding of today's consumers and the dynamic marketplace of the web. We believe that RedEnvelope will quickly make its mark as the internet's premier gift site."

releases.title: RedEnvelope Gifts Online Launches on October 28 as Premier Gift-Giving Website; Former 911gifts.com Site Transformed with New Look and Exciting New Gift Offerings
releases.summary: Launch of RedEnvelope Gifts Online as the rebranded successor to 911gifts.com, under President & CEO Hilary Billings, after a $21 million Sequoia-led round. Her name appears as press contact on the Oct 2000 website copy (contacts may have been updated after original issue).
releases.text:
October 28, 1999
Press Contact: Amy Burke Bessette, RedEnvelope, (415) 371-9100 x237, aburke@redenvelope.com

REDENVELOPE GIFTS ONLINE LAUNCHES ON OCTOBER 28 AS PREMIER GIFT-GIVING WEBSITE
FORMER 911GIFTS.COM SITE TRANSFORMED WITH NEW LOOK AND EXCITING NEW GIFT OFFERINGS

(SAN FRANCISCO, CA - October 28, 1999) -- Online gift shopping takes an innovative step forward with today's launch of an exciting new website, RedEnvelope Gifts Online, located at www.redenvelope.com. Formerly called 911gifts.com, which had become a leader in the online gifts category, the new website has been completely redesigned and enhanced, offering a new and considerably larger selection of merchandise at all price points. RedEnvelope recently closed a $21 million round of financing, led by Sequoia Capital, to facilitate the growth and expansion of the business.

Under the creative direction of President & CEO Hilary Billings, RedEnvelope offers a unique and distinctive point of view in its selection of gifts - presented in an elegant, easy-to-navigate environment. Before joining RedEnvelope, Billings created the brand concept and design of the W Hotels group as Senior Vice-President of Brand Design for Starwood Hotels and Resorts Worldwide (NYSE:HOT). Prior to that, as Vice-President of Product Development and Design for Pottery Barn, Billings spent seven years leading the repositioning that built the company into the industry leader it is today.

Billings plans to establish RedEnvelope as the definitive resource for unique and stylish gifts online. She comments, "We've assembled an incredible array of gifts for people to choose from, over twice the number of offerings we had previously. Many of these gifts have been created exclusively for RedEnvelope by individual artisans as well as some of the world's top gift companies."

The name, RedEnvelope, comes from an ancient tradition - which lives on today - of enclosing special gifts inside a red envelope. In the spirit of this tradition, gifts purchased from RedEnvelope are accompanied by a personalized message in a red envelope and can be gift wrapped in a red box with a wide ivory grosgrain ribbon and hand-tied bow.

The transformation of 911gifts.com into RedEnvelope places the website at the forefront of the online gift market, which is poised to become big business this holiday season and into the year 2000, generating an estimated $7.2 billion in consumer spending for 1999 and nearly double that, or $13.2 billion, for 2000 - comprising over a third of all online consumer spending.

911gifts.com, launched in September 1997, quickly gathered a strong following by providing a new level of convenience to gift shoppers through easy navigation, broad selection and last-minute delivery. Building on 911gifts.com, Billings and her team will bring the site and its offerings to a new level, providing not only enhanced efficiency and quick delivery, but also a superior selection of merchandise - a sophisticated, stylish mix of items in all categories from accessories to home décor to pets to gadgets to gourmet food baskets. Says Billings, "We want RedEnvelope to be the place people go whenever they need just the right gift for anyone, whether it's one month or one day before the occasion." Gift offerings include ideas for Him, Her, Kids, Pets as well as occasions such as weddings, birthdays and a new baby. The site also includes gift ideas for people of all lifestyles such as the explorer, the epicure, the weekend warrior and the spa seeker and specialty shops such as home accessories, healthy living and gourmet food baskets.

RedEnvelope's simple, elegant design makes the process of finding, selecting and purchasing a gift online easy and hassle-free. Several unique features help guide customers to the gift they want, including: GiftSearch, GiftReminder, 911Gifts (guaranteed overnight delivery), online customer service, multiple addressing and an inventory system that tracks in real-time which eliminates the frustration of finding out later that the selected item is out of stock.

Hilary Billings is joined at RedEnvelope by merchandisers from Macy's, Nature Company/Discovery Stores, Imaginarium and Williams-Sonoma and an executive team with expertise in the specialty retail and e-commerce arenas. Chief Operating Officer Tom Bazzone comes to RedEnvelope from Williams-Sonoma (NYSE:WSM) where he was VP, Inventory Management for the Internet and five Catalog divisions. The company's Board of Directors also has considerable expertise in the worlds of both e-commerce and retail branding, including: Michael Moritz, a partner at Sequoia Capital and Director of Yahoo! (Nasdaq:YHOO) and eToys (Nasdaq:ETYS); Pat Connolly, Executive Vice President of Williams-Sonoma, Inc.; and Scott Galloway, CEO of Prophet Brand Strategy. Says Moritz, "At some point - years from now - we hope that it will be second nature for people to use RedEnvelope as a way to express affection, friendship, devotion and love. Hilary Billings and her team are providing a panoply of gifts - for holidays, anniversaries, birthdays and those occasions when a red envelope can become an expression of something special."
# # #

releases.title: 911gifts.com Closes $21MM Financing Led by Sequoia Capital; New CEO Hilary Billings Plans to Re-launch as 'Lifestyle' Gift Brand
releases.summary: 911gifts.com announced a $21M Sequoia-led round, Michael Moritz joining the board, Hilary Billings as CEO/President and Tom Bazzone as COO. Her name appears as press contact on the Oct 2000 website copy; the site appears to have retroactively updated contacts on older releases, so the original issue may have listed someone else.
releases.text:
August 3, 1999
Press Contact: Amy Burke Bessette, RedEnvelope, (415) 371-9100 x237, aburke@redenvelope.com

911GIFTS.COM CLOSES $21MM FINANCING LED BY SEQUOIA CAPITAL
NEW CEO HILARY BILLINGS PLANS TO RE-LAUNCH AS "LIFESTYLE" GIFT BRAND

SAN FRANCISCO, California--911gifts.com, the leading internet gift site, today announced the closing of a $21mm round of financing as well a new management team which plans to dramatically build upon and expand beyond the company's early success.

The investment was led by Sequoia Capital. Joining Sequoia in this round are AMB Ventures, venture capitalist Ron Conway as well as previous investors including: Pat Connolly, Executive Vice President of Williams-Sonoma, Inc; Sippl Macdonald Ventures and venture capitalist Henry Wilder.

Michael Moritz, a partner at Sequoia Capital and a Director of Yahoo!, eToys, and WebVan, will join the company's Board of Directors.

The company also announced the appointment of Hilary Billings to the CEO/President position and the addition of Tom Bazzone as Chief Operating Officer. Billings joined the company in May as Chief Merchandising Officer. Prior to 911gifts.com, she was Senior Vice President at Starwood Hotels and Resorts Worldwide where she was responsible for the brand development and launch of the new "W" Hotels, a unique chain of stylish accommodations for business travelers. Prior to Starwood, Billings spent seven years with Pottery Barn, where she was pivotal in raising total annual revenue for the retail and mail order divisions to $400 million. Bazzone, who will oversee all operational and merchandising activities for the company, comes to 911gifts.com from Williams-Sonoma, Inc. where he was VP, Inventory Management for the Internet and all 5 Catalog divisions.

"With annual revenue growth exceeding 500%, it is clear that the first generation of this concept registers with Internet shoppers. Our partnership with Sequoia allows us to now enhance our focus on style and quality. We plan to address and invest in every aspect of our customer's experience: from our name, merchandise assortment and packaging to the site's navigational ease and our customer service. The result will be establishing brand leadership as the premier retailer of gifts online," said Hilary Billings, CEO/President. "Before this investment, Sequoia Capital was in business with two of the most innovative retailers in the nation- Toby Lenk of eToys and Louis Borders of WebVan," stated Michael Mortiz. "Now we are delighted to partner with another creative force: Hilary Billings. She will transform the gift business with the same flair and passion with which Toby is transforming the toy business and Louis is changing the grocery business."

About 911gifts.com
Launched in September 1997 in San Francisco, 911gifts.com has quickly established itself as the internet's leading gift site. The company now plans to build on this early success by leveraging management's track record in developing lifestyle brands. Stay tuned...

releases.title: 911gifts.com Enjoys Robust Father's Day, Surpassing 1998 Sales 10 Times Over
releases.summary: 911gifts.com reported Father's Day sales near $1 million, 10x the prior year (page header misprints the date as June 24, 2000). releases.text:
June 24, 2000 [sic; listed on the press index as June 24, 1999]
Press Contact: Amy Burke Bessette, RedEnvelope, (415) 371-9100 x237, aburke@redenvelope.com

911GIFTS.COM ENJOYS ROBUST FATHER'S DAY, SURPASSING 1998 SALES 10 TIMES OVER

SAN FRANCISCO, California--911gifts.com today announced record-breaking Father's Day results, demonstrating strong growth and consumer response to its leading online gift-shopping experience and merchandise selection.

Father's Day sales on 911gifts.com reached almost $1 million, more than 10 times greater than last year. The week before Father's Day also marked the first time 911gifts.com entered Nielsen/NetRatings' Top Ten Advertisers list for the Web, with the site ranking as the top banner ad for reach and the fifth most viewed ad banner overall.

"We are thrilled with the growth we achieved for Father's Day, and expect to build on it through the holidays and into the millennium," said Hilary Billings, president & CEO of 911gifts.com. "Our focus is on enhancing our position as the ultimate online gift destination, and customers have unmistakably responded to our ability to provide a targeted collection of great gifts for any occasion."

Hot sellers for Father's Day included the Y2K self-powered radio and flashlight, followed by the full body massage mat and fresh baked cookies in a fly fishing basket.

911gifts.com has created a service specifically designed for online gift shoppers, recognizing their need for an effortless shopping experience, great gifts and quick delivery. Features such as GiftExpert and GiftSearch serve as "virtual personal shoppers," combing through gift ideas to select a customized short list, saving valuable time in selecting a gift. Gifts available for overnight delivery, some as late as midnight EDT, are easily identifiable by the QuickGifts icon. Finally, 911gift.com's unique GiftAlert service sends email reminders and gift ideas for important gift-giving events, such as birthdays and anniversaries.

About 911gifts.com
911gifts.com was launched in September, 1997, to address a clear unmet consumer need in the fast growing online gift market. Based in San Francisco, 911gifts.com is widely recognized as the premier online destination for shoppers in search of the perfect gift. 911gifts.com combines new levels of convenience, advice and gift selection with last minute delivery. 911gifts.com also makes it easy to remember important gift-giving occasions with its free GiftAlert email reminder service. 911gifts.com's tagline perfectly expresses the company's mission, helping customers to find "the right gift, right away."

releases.title: 911gifts.com Pursues Lifestyle Branding Effort with New Chief Merchandising Officer Hilary Billings
releases.summary: 911gifts.com named former W Hotels/Pottery Barn executive Hilary Billings chief merchandising officer. Her name appears as press contact on the Oct 2000 website copy; the site appears to have retroactively updated contacts on older releases, so the original issue may have listed someone else.
releases.text:
June 8, 1999
Press Contact: Amy Burke Bessette, RedEnvelope, (415) 371-9100 x237, aburke@redenvelope.com

911GIFTS.COM PURSUES LIFESTYLE BRANDING EFFORT WITH NEW CHIEF MERCHANDISING OFFICER HILARY BILLINGS
W HOTELS AND POTTERY BARN EXECUTIVE BRINGS DISTINCTIVE POINT OF VIEW TO ONLINE GIFT SHOPPING LEADER

SAN FRANCISCO, Calif.--Staking its claim to elevate 911gifts.com into a strong consumer brand in addition to market leader, the company today announced the addition of Hilary Billings as chief merchandising officer. About 911gifts.com
911gifts.com was launched in September, 1997, to address a clear unmet consumer need in the fast growing online gift market. Based in San Francisco, 911gifts.com is widely recognized as the premier online destination for shoppers in search of the perfect gift. 911gifts.com combines new levels of convenience, advice and gift selection with last minute delivery. 911gifts.com also makes it easy to remember important gift-giving occasions with its free GiftAlert email reminder service. 911gifts.com's tagline perfectly expresses the company's mission, helping customers to find "the right gift, right away."
